title: PeerRank: Autonomous LLM Evaluation Through Web-Grounded, Bias-Controlled Peer Review

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the difference between a model's self-assigned score for its own generated answer and the mean score assigned to that answer by peer models.
Comparing peer evaluation scores under a regime where model identities are visible (shuffle-only) against a baseline where model identities are hidden (shuffle+blind).
Comparing peer evaluation scores under a regime with a fixed answer presentation order (blind-only) against a baseline with a randomized presentation order (shuffle+blind).
